dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good morning, class! Open your book, please.
dialogue.reading: ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ˈklæs! ˈoʊpən jʊr ˈbʊk, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry! I don't have my book.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri! aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv maɪ ˈbʊk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's OK. Look at the board, please.
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈbɔːrd, ˈpliːz.
